resources.string: Below the threshold (not charging) the video plays at a lower resolution and at most 30 fps. The full quality is back 5 % above it or on the charger. A quality you pick in the player wins until the next video.
Lower the quality while the system\'s battery saver is on, whatever the battery level.
At 20, 15, 10 and 5 % the video moves in briefly and shows the level\'s colour around it, with a vibration of its own per level (only with \"Custom haptics\" on).
